favorite: (A little happy) You like this outfit? I'll make a note of that, too.
I'm quite happy you chose to save this one.
unfavorite: Feel like trying something different? Sure.
It's okay. You can take your time choosing outfits.
replay: (With a hint of a smile) You want to see it again? Okay.
I'll do it one more time. I'll make sure to give you a good look this time, too.
pause: Okay, let's pause for a little while.
Take your time. There's no rush.
resume: Had enough of this little break? I'll carry on, then.
edit: Take your time choosing. Pick something you like looking at.
(With a hint of a smile) I'll let you choose this time. I want to see your taste, too.
saved: So this is the moment you like? I'll remember that.
(Smiles softly) Okay, let's keep it here.
cancel: Then let's stick with the original for now. No rush to change.
It's fine to leave things as they are. I like that original moment, too.
reset: Mm, let's take another look at that original moment.
We're back where we started. Take another look and see if you still like it.
wake: (In a soft voice) Would you like to hear me say something?

fixed.freeze: Let's stay right here, at the moment you like. Take your time.
fixed.single: You want to see this outfit again? Then let's do it one more time.
fixed.all: I'll change outfits one by one. Take your time choosing.
fixed.favorites: Then let's look at the ones you've marked as favorites. No rush.
fixed.ready: Tap play whenever you're ready. I'll wait for you.
